cohort: 11,662 patients with singleton pregnancies and small for gestational age (SGA) infants
finding: GDM was independently associated with adverse neonatal outcomes, including lower Apgar scores, meconium aspiration, seizures, and hypoglycemia, among SGA infants.
mod_finding: Patients with GDM and SGA infants had higher rates of overall and spontaneous preterm birth, unplanned cesarean, and postpartum hemorrhage.
